question: Distinguish sampling-dependent event memory, local integration error, and predictor leakage on actual first-epoch states before choosing a repair or a functional error contract.

rivals.A: Adaptive sample cadence changes detector memory and event quantization; same states and identical steps match.
rivals.B: Independent block arithmetic or local step control changes physical states beyond the inherited tolerance; matched-step replay refutes A alone.
rivals.C: Predictor rollback is incomplete after the first epoch; full evolving-state and publisher comparison detects a leak.

operations: Add sideband buffers for selected KC cells at each accepted half-step in native CUDA; capture first two physical epochs and their pre-epoch inputs for replay. Check rollback at each of the first 16 coupling boundaries. Diagnostic buffers are never read by model decisions. Compare on/off complete scientific state separately for both engines.

criteria.observer_neutrality: bitwise complete scientific state within each engine
criteria.event_discrete: exact accepted IDs/counts; report all time differences without widening tolerance
criteria.repair_gate: only a concrete implementation bug or a prospectively defined algorithmic candidate; preserve failed historical gate

stop: At budget, diagnostic corruption, or a causal finding. No post-hoc widening of the state tolerance; no biological weight or decoder adjustment.
